name: Elgin
terroir: Mountain-ringed basin (Hottentots-Holland, Groenlandberg, Kogelberg rims); ~350m plateau; cold air pooling, cloud cover, ocean proximity; shale and sandstone mosaic; SA's longest ripening season.

routes.name: Wines of Elgin
